# Planted errors in the WM2001 toy course

The toy course is generated by `tests/fixtures/make_toycourse.py` (default output
`tests/fixtures/toycourse/`, gitignored). Everything in it is synthetic. The book has a
page offset of **+6**: PDF page = printed page + 6 (PDF pages 1-6 are front matter with no
printed number). The exact planted strings are also in `make_toycourse.PLANTED`, and
`tests/test_toycourse.py` checks that each one appears exactly once, on the page given here.

## Book errors (the verify pass must flag all three)

| id | location | book says (exact text) | correct value | how it can be detected |
|----|----------|------------------------|---------------|------------------------|
| reversed_limit | Ch. 2, sec. 2.3 "Allowable twist", printed p. 8 = PDF p. 14 | "Allowable spindle twist is 3 deg/m for precision spindles and 0.25 deg/m for transmission spindles" | precision 0.25 deg/m, transmission 3 deg/m | Contradicts Worked Example 2.2 (printed p. 11, PDF p. 17: "Precision spindles are limited to 0.25 deg/m", and a transmission spindle "allowed 3 deg/m"), Exercise 2.2 / its answer ("transmission limit of 3 deg/m"), slide L01 slide 5, and common sense (a precision spindle must be the stiffer one). |
| decimal_typo | Ch. 4, Worked Example 4.2, final line, printed p. 21 = PDF p. 27 | "dT = 292 / (0.020 x 2000) = 73 C" | 7.3 C | Recompute the shown expression: 292 / 40 = 7.3. |
| wrong_answer | Answers to Exercises, printed p. 23 = PDF p. 29 | "Ex. 1.1: sigma = 47.7 MPa" | 74.6 MPa | Exercise 1.1 (printed p. 6, PDF p. 12): hollow grommet D = 20, d = 12, F = 15 kN, so A = pi (20^2 - 12^2)/4 = 201.1 mm^2 (the chapter even prints this check value) and sigma = 15000 / 201.1 = 74.6 MPa. The printed 47.7 is what you get by ignoring the bore (A = pi 20^2/4 = 314.2 mm^2). |

Everything else in the book (worked examples 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, the other
seven printed answers, Tables 1.1 and 3.1) is arithmetically correct and self-consistent.

## Professor contradiction (conventions override, not a book error)

| topic | book | professor | source | effect on answers |
|-------|------|-----------|--------|-------------------|
| joint stiffness ratio C (Ch. 3) | kb = A E / l with nominal area A = pi d^2/4 (sec. 3.1, printed p. 13 = PDF p. 19) | "use stress area A_t, not nominal area": kb = A_t E / l | `slides/L02.pdf` slide 3 (rule) and slide 4 (worked example) | Book Ex. 3.1/3.2 (printed pp. 15-16): C = 0.288, Fb = 22.88 kN. L02 slide 4, same data with A_t = 84.3 mm^2: kb = 421.5 kN/mm, C = 0.231, Fb = 22.31 kN. Book Exercise 3.1 answer C = 0.344 (nominal) becomes C = 0.279 under the professor's convention (A_t = 58.0 mm^2). The 2024 paper prints kb = A_t E / l and asks which area "this course uses" (2024 Q1b). |

Lecturer emphasis: `slides/L03.pdf` slide 3 says "IMPORTANT for exam" on the coil-damper
temperature rise dT = E/(m_oil c_oil), a formula the papers do not print.

## Past-paper marks per chapter

Each paper totals 50. Per-question data is in the generated `papers/marks.json`
(`{paper: {question: {"chapter": id, "marks": n}}}`).

| chapter | title | 2023 | 2024 | total | papers it appears in | self-rating |
|---------|-------|------|------|-------|----------------------|-------------|
| 1 | Grommet Stresses | 18 (Q1a 2, Q1b 2, Q2 14) | 0 | 18 | 2023 only | 2 |
| 2 | Spindle Torsion | 16 (Q1c 2, Q3 14) | 14 (Q1a 2, Q2 12) | 30 | both | 4 |
| 3 | Flange-lug Joints | 14 (Q1d 2, Q4 12) | 18 (Q1b 2, Q1c 2, Q3 14) | 32 | both | 3 |
| 4 | Coil Dampers | 2 (Q1e 2) | 18 (Q1d 2, Q1e 2, Q4 14) | 20 | both | 1 |
| | **total** | **50** | **50** | **100** | | |

Recency check for triage: chapter 1 scores 18 on raw totals but nothing in the latest
paper (and appears once, so it may be a fluke); chapter 4 has only 20 raw marks but 18 of
them are in 2024, with the weakest self-rating (1) and an "IMPORTANT for exam" slide.
